player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tshikandakanda etshi tshidi ne bua kuikala mu mushindu wa [macro micro] muikale ne nimero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Bintu bionso bidi ne bua kuikala pankatshi pa 0 ne 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mikebelu ya mikese, mulongo anyi dikosa ki mmikumbane to.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Muena manaya udi ne bua kunanga mu tshisanji tshikuabu.

next_board.any: tshiamu tshia mikese ya bungi (micro board)

game_action.played: Player {player_id} played in micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} must now play in {nxt_txt}.
